import unreal,json
from pathlib import Path
material=unreal.load_asset('/Game/Materials/MM_Landscape')
def trace(node,depth=0):
 if not node or depth>8: return None
 result={'name':node.get_name(),'class':node.get_class().get_name()}
 if isinstance(node,unreal.MaterialExpressionConstant3Vector):
  c=node.get_editor_property('constant');result['rgb']=[c.r,c.g,c.b]
 else: result['inputs']=[trace(x,depth+1) for x in unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary.get_inputs_for_material_expression(material,node) if x]
 return result
blend=next(o for o in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.MaterialExpressionLandscapeLayerBlend) if o.get_outermost()==material.get_outermost())
inputs=unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary.get_inputs_for_material_expression(material,blend)
rows=[]
for layer,expression in zip(blend.get_editor_property('layers'),inputs):
 branch=unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary.get_inputs_for_material_expression(material,expression)
 rows.append({'layer':str(layer.get_editor_property('LayerName')),'blend_type':str(layer.get_editor_property('BlendType')),'debug_branch':trace(branch[1])})
Path('C:/Users/tarik/Documents/GitHub/AGP/.scratch/splatmap-v2/manual-acceptance-20261024/51-named-debug-colors.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
